5186.title: [release/4.151.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding
5186.body:
[release/4.151.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding (#5186)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162
Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/377
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/ad2b1b49da724dc996c773043075eed32690aa6c...74fb56c9f097a1241f38542d31e2edcbe685178b

Backport the RAW/DNG retirement to M151 while preserving the public ABI
and keeping dependency acquisition consistent with codec availability.

~~ Codec support and ABI ~~

SkiaSharp 4.151 should no longer decode RAW/DNG through Adobe's DNG SDK
or extract embedded JPEG previews with PIEX. Disable both GN options in
the shared native configuration, remove conflicting platform overrides
and the DNG-only Alpine __WORDSIZE workaround.

Remove DNG from the Gallery picker. Preserve the original media bytes as
a test fixture and cover unsupported file, managed-stream, SKData,
SKBitmap, and SKImage decoding.

Keep SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng at numeric value 10 for ABI compatibility.
No replacement RAW reader, C API change, or milestone update is added.

~~ Dependency downloads and provenance ~~

The merged native backport comments out dng_sdk and piex in DEPS, so
dependency synchronization no longer downloads unused source trees.
Remove their Component Governance entries and repin both the submodule
and manifest to native merge 74fb56c9f097a1241f38542d31e2edcbe685178b.
Its tree is identical to the reviewed native PR head. Update the related
build, dependency, image-format, and Gallery documentation.

The macOS ARM64 native and Gallery shared builds passed; the new DNG
regression did not fail. The local unfiltered console suite did not pass:
Ganesh GL DiagonalLines failed identically on an untouched release base,
and a first-run managed-stream failure passed on rerun. No golden,
tolerance, or skip was changed. The maintainer accepted the documented
validation limitations for manual landing, not as a green-test claim.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
